subject: Partner account deconflict: CloudSync / Consultly boundary & handoff playbook
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@cloudsync.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Doug Harris <doug.harris@consultly.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + territory overlap with Consultly on Acme POC

Hi Karthik —

Quick intro: I run partnerships at CloudSync (we provide managed connectors for data pipelines — the plugin Acme is evaluating for their internal tools). Priya mentioned Consultly is already engaged on integration consulting; Doug cc'd here. We want to make sure there's a clean handoff and to avoid duplicated outreach.

High level: Acme is interested in a 3-month POC to validate data-sync and inference pipelines. CloudSync can provide connectors and integration support; Consultly is offering system-integration and change management.

Can we map account ownership and agree on a single point of contact for commercial talks so we can coordinate pricing and SOW scope?

I attached a quick coverage CSV (partner-coverage-csv.xlsx) with accounts we think overlap. Happy to jump on a 30-min call next week.

Best,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, CloudSync
From: Doug Harris <doug.harris@consultly.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Samantha Ruiz <samantha@cloudsync.io>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + territory overlap with Consultly on Acme POC

On Mon, Jun 22, 2026 at 09:55 AM Samantha Ruiz <samantha@cloudsync.io> wrote:
> Quick intro...

Hey all — thanks for looping me in. Consultly has been doing discovery with Acme for three weeks; our team was asked to scope integration and migration effort. We do not have an exclusive with Acme, and we want to avoid stepping on CloudSync's commercial relationship.

Proposal: Let Redwood coordinate a short partner alignment meeting where we confirm scope split (connectors vs SI), agree who drives commercial engagement with Acme, and lock a mutual action plan (MAP). If Redwood can own the MAP and the single commercial thread, that reduces confusion for the buyer.

Doug
Senior Director, Services — Consultly
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@cloudsync.io>, Doug Harris <doug.harris@consultly.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + territory overlap with Consultly on Acme POC

Thanks Samantha & Doug — great context. Priya, thanks for making intros.

I agree with Doug: Redwood will act as the coordinator for the MAP and commercial thread for this opportunity to keep decision-making centralized. Suggestions from our side: 
- CloudSync: lead connector delivery and onboarding (technical scope).
- Consultly: lead implementation, data migration, and change management.
- Redwood: own licensing conversation, SOW sign-off cadence, and the MAP running sheet.

Action items before the alignment call:
1) Partners to confirm named resources and estimated LOEs (attachments preferred).
2) Redwood to share our deconflict playbook draft and proposed account boundary table.
3) Acme (Priya) to confirm preferred commercial contact and any procurement constraints.

I've attached Acme-MAP-2026-06-22.docx and pulled a first draft of the playbook (deconflict-playbook-v1.pdf). Can you both review and we'll set a 45-min call Thurs 24th or Mon 28th?

—Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: account boundaries draft & commission implications

Internal note (not for external):

Karthik — quick read of the playbook: looks good, but we need to flag commission splits and referral credit before calling contacts. If Consultly ends up billing implementation as a separate SOW, SalesOps needs clear rules on ACV attribution vs services revenue.

Proposed split for this opportunity: Redwood license revenue to AE (Karthik) for any annualized license sold to Acme; 10% referral credit to CloudSync on first-year license if they drove technical close; consult services (Consultly) tracked as professional services and not counted as ACV.

I'll draft a short note to send post-call to both partners to avoid surprises.

-Marissa
Director, Partnerships Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@cloudsync.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Doug Harris <doug.harris@consultly.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + territory overlap with Consultly on Acme POC

Thanks — reviewed the draft playbook and LOE asks. CloudSync confirms resources: myself (partnership lead), Ravi Patel (solutions engineer) — initial 40 hours for connector adaptions, then 8 hrs/week during POC. Attachment: partner-coverage-csv.xlsx updated with our contact column.

The 10% referral sounds fair; we ask that referral credit be paid on the first-year license value once contract is signed. We'll mark up the MAP with expected milestones for connector deliverables.

Available for the 45-min alignment call today at 4pm PT or Monday 10am PT.

—Samantha
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@cloudsync.io>, Doug Harris <doug.harris@consultly.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Alignment call notes & next steps (Acme MAP)

Thanks for joining today — notes below and next steps. See also updated playbook and boundary table in the drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Axyz/partner-mapping

Call summary:
- Scope split confirmed: CloudSync = connectors; Consultly = SI & migration.
- Redwood = commercial owner for the licensing thread and will circulate a single SOW template referencing partner deliverables.
- Commission: Redwood AE (Karthik) recognized for license ACV; CloudSync referral credit at 10% on first-year license (payable after contract signature); Consultly professional services excluded from license ACV.
- Single point-of-contact for Acme commercial: Priya Menon (buyer). Technical POC lead: Ravi Patel (CloudSync).

Immediate next steps:
1) Partners to provide LOE estimates by Wed 30 Jun.
2) Redwood to send a draft SOW + single commercial thread email to Priya by EOD 30 Jun.
3) SalesOps (Marissa) to log referral arrangement and create commission ticket.

I'll route the commercial email and attach the SOW draft — want to keep a single thread with Acme moving forward.

—Karthik
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@cloudsync.io>, Doug Harris <doug.harris@consultly.com>, Alex Boyd <aboyd@integrations.inc>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alignment call notes & next steps (Acme MAP)

Karthik — thanks for the detailed notes and for owning the commercial thread. We appreciate all three teams aligning.

Quick confirmations: we accept the scope split and will review the SOW. Procurement note: Acme requires a single consolidated invoice for license + services by vendor preference; can you confirm whether we should route license via Redwood and services via Consultly/CloudSync individually (we will handle internal cost centers), or if Redwood should consolidate and invoice on our behalf?

I'll loop Legal if needed once we see the SOW.

Regards,
Priya Menon
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Corp
